subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3442
title: Exempts from the requirement to obtain a money transmission license a person that assists with or facilitates payment for goods or services under the terms of a contract with a payee if the person does not engage in money transmission and if payment to the person satisfies or otherwise extinguishes a payor's obligation to the payee.
headline: HB 3442 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3442 was introduced in the House on January 28, 2025.
HB 3442 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
